item.title: Dimensions of Extensibility
item.description: A response to the first Malleable Systems Challenge Problem, exploring dimensions of extensibility including open vs. closed extensibility, trust and authority, orthogonality, compositionality, and substrates.

item.title: On Compositional Window Management
item.description: Window management is one of the least valued categories of software given how heavily used it is. I explore how composing window managers could make applications more malleable.

item.title: Flatten the Program Lifecycle
item.description: The traditional way we break down the Program Lifecycle is keeping us from making radical improvements in Computing. Flattening the lifecycle by unifying edit time, compile time, and run time could bridge the gap between programming and interactive computing.

item.title: Continuous Delivery
item.description: Updating the blog to Gatsby v2 and setting up CI/CD with GitHub Actions for automatic deployment to GitHub Pages.

item.title: Initial Post
item.description: Now that I have some free time off from school I've decided to rebuild the blog. I'm using Gatsby with markdown pages for content.
